newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Capricorn eyeing new nickel mine prospect.
newsitem.headline: Capricorn eyeing new nickel mine prospect.

text.p: A new nickel prospect may lie near the rich Emily Ann discovery in Western Australia, Capricorn Resources Australia NL said on Wednesday.
However, Capricorn managing director Tony Gates said it was too early to assess the most recent drill tests from the six-kilometre target zone, named Speilers.
Assay results should be returned to Capricorn late on June 26 or June 27, Gates said.
"Possibly Monday will be an announcement day," Gates told Reuters.
The potential find lies north of the Emily Ann deposit, located within the Roundtop joint venture.
Preliminary metallurgical tests indicate concentrate grades at Emily Ann of between 11.3 percent and 14.2 percent and recoveries of 89.2 percent to 96.2 percent, Gates said.
Capricorn holds a 25 percent stake in the Roundtop joint venture, a grouping of four prospects some 450 km southeast of Perth.
South Africa's Gencor Ltd holds 37.5 percent of the venture and the Forrestania Gold division of Canada's Lionore Mining International Ltd 37.5 percent.
